title: Add comprehensive strategic analysis reports for business model and product design
body:
Strategic analysis of ObjectStack's position in the AI-driven enterprise software landscape, examining technical completeness, competitive advantages, and commercialization paths.

## Deliverables

- **`STRATEGIC_REPORT.md`** (中文, 1,080 lines) - Complete analysis for Chinese market stakeholders
- **`STRATEGIC_REPORT_EN.md`** (English, 483 lines) - International version
- Updated `README.md` with strategic reports section

## Analysis Scope

**Technical Foundation**:
- Analyzed 1,854+ Zod protocol schemas across 11 domains
- Evaluated microkernel architecture, plugin ecosystem, and AI integration depth
- Identified industry-first capabilities: 11 AI-native protocols (Agent, RAG, NLQ, Orchestration)

**Market Positioning**:
- Competitive analysis vs Salesforce/ServiceNow/Odoo across 7 dimensions
- Target market segmentation (SaaS startups, tech SMBs, consulting firms)
- "Protocol as Product" moat thesis - when AI generates features from protocols, standardization becomes competitive advantage

**Commercial Strategy**:
- 4-tier monetization model: open-core ($30-100/user/mo), AI marketplace (30% rev share), managed hosting, professional services
- 18-month roadmap: foundation (Q1) → developer experience (Q2) → AI capabilities (Q3) → commercialization (Q4)
- Ecosystem targets: 10K certified developers, 500+ plugins within 3 years

## Key Insights

**AI Multiplier Effect**: Traditional platform efficiency = Manpower × Experience. ObjectStack = (Manpower × Experience) × AI coefficient (1.5x → 10x), enabling 2-hour delivery vs 2-week industry standard.

**Protocol Completeness vs Feature Completeness**: Unlike incumbents competing on feature count, ObjectStack's 1,854 schemas enable AI-driven feature generation, creating network effects as protocols standardize.

Reports provide strategic roadmap for Series A positioning and go-to-market execution.
